Types

UploadedFile = object
  found*: bool               ## Form field name the file was submitted under.
  field*: string             ## Original filename reported by the client.
  name*: string              ## File size in bytes.
  size*: int                 ## Path on disk when the upload was streamed to a file.
  path*: string              ## In-memory file content when not stored on disk.
  data*: string
True when a file with this field name was found. 
WindowRangeResolveResult = object
  ok*: bool                  ## Canonical `unit=start-end` range string.
  value*: string             ## Reason text when resolution failed.
  error*: string
True when value holds a valid range.
